title: NightEye
summary: A Raspberry Pi night vision headset using infrared imaging and machine vision.

cover.alt: Grayscale infrared view of a person with a white box drawn around their face

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: A modular night vision headset capable of infrared-spectrum imaging and facial detection.

With a Raspberry Pi 5 microcomputer serving as the design's foundation, efficiency in both power and processing is ensured. The headset leverages machine vision and artificial intelligence for real-time feature analysis.

images.alt: Headset prototype with two camera modules and ribbon cables resting on a wooden block
